name: gitlab-panel
description: Your open GitLab merge requests beside the chat, across the projects you pick: pipeline, merge status, conflicts and comments, live; open, copy or comment from the panel.

projects.title: Projects to watch
projects.description: Comma-separated GitLab projects: a full path (group/sub/name) or a bare name matched against the last path segment. Empty shows your open MRs in every project.

glab.title: glab executable
glab.description: Path or name of the glab CLI, which must be signed in (glab auth status)

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: Re-reads your open MRs this often. 0 turns polling off (refresh with r or /gitlab refresh).

instructClaude.title: Tell Claude about the panel
instructClaude.description: Adds a short system-prompt section naming the watched projects and the mrs tool
